cards.subtitle: Turning your intake into a profile the village can search.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: New intake. Parsing background, current work, and what you're seeking.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Reasoning over the raw text — extracting trajectory, not just keywords.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Draft profile: ex-finance, building agent infra, seeking a cofounder.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Draft leans on topic tags. Where they're headed matters more.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Adding trajectory: left finance 2yrs ago, shipping solo, wants a team.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Profile now encodes path, stage, and the explicit ask.

script.speaker: actian
script.text: Embedded and indexed in the vector store. Searchable.

cards.subtitle: Fetching the candidates before anyone argues about them.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · CANDIDATE POOL IS WIDE ENOUGH

script.speaker: actian
script.text: Pulled 30 nearest neighbours for the new profile.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: First pass rank by domain similarity. Finance folk on top.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: That pool is one topic clump. Landing rate there was 41%.

script.speaker: actian
script.text: Widening the pull — neighbours by trajectory vectors too.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Reviewed the pool: mixed domains, similar arcs. Healthier spread.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Candidate set locked. Ranking round is next.

cards.subtitle: Deciding who actually goes in front of you.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Scoring the pool. Domain overlap still dominates my top five.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Same-topic matches landed 41% historically. Not good enough.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Weight what they're seeking and the path they're on.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Re-ranking. Two topic matches drop, two trajectory matches rise.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: New top pick mirrors your path — same pivot, same ask.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: My scorer rates the new top three above the old list.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Conceded. Shared trajectory beats shared topic.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Queueing intros for the top three.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Scored 60 held-out connections with the fine-tuned model.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Topic-only pairs still landing near 41%. Trajectory pairs far above.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Some domain pairs did land. Keep a little domain weight.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Held-out scores agree: domain helps only alongside a shared ask.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Refit: domain demoted to a tiebreaker, seeking-fit promoted.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Rationale logged for the next generation.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: New weights accepted for generation six.

cards.subtitle: Rolling the new weights across the whole graph.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Connection-rate since generation 0: 41% → 84%.

script.speaker: pioneer
script.text: Fine-tuned scorer validated on held-out pairs. No regression.

script.speaker: matcher
script.text: Re-clustering the graph — topic clumps dissolving into arcs.

script.speaker: actian
script.text: Vector store refreshed with the reweighted embeddings.

script.speaker: profiler
script.text: Existing profiles re-read cleanly under the new weights.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Generation six is live. Rolling the graph.

cards.subtitle: Writing the opener that starts the conversation.
cards.statusLine: CONSENSUS · OPENER LEADS WITH THE SHARED PATH

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Drafting the opener for your top match via BAND.

script.speaker: band
script.text: First draft leads with the shared finance background.

script.speaker: evaluator
script.text: Topic openers stall. Lead with the shared pivot and the ask.

script.speaker: gemini
script.text: Reframed: both left finance to build, both looking for a cofounder.

script.speaker: band
script.text: Redraft reads warm and specific. Two lines, one question.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Both sides opted in. Sending the intro.

script.speaker: introducer
script.text: Introduction delivered. Watching for the reply.
